general_rules: Execution completion cannot upgrade a PARTIAL_SCOPED, UNVERIFIED, or BLOCKED claim.
Every source and consumer key is a hash-addressed contract; current-live identity is separate from historical pinned bytes.
Every actual collision candidate receives narrow-phase evidence; same-node/family/table blanket exemptions are invalid.
Representative proof covers every active support/load template before propagation, not only one optical component.
Multi-state topology requires explicit state membership and ray expansion when applicable.
Visual and package-integrity PASS remain independent from physical and performance claims.
